title: Single Image Haze Removal Using Dark Channel Prior
authors: Kaiming He, Jian Sun, Xiaoou Tang
publisher: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
annotation: The seminal paper on single-image dehazing introducing the Dark Channel Prior for transmission map estimation without paired ground truth.

title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
authors: Chuan Guo, Geoff Pleiss, Yu Sun, Kilian Q. Weinberger
annotation: Foundational paper defining Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and demonstrating that modern deep networks are severely miscalibrated and overconfident.

title: Benchmarking Single-Image Dehazing and Beyond
authors: Boyi Li, Wenqi Ren, Dengpan Fu, Dacheng Tao, Dan Feng, Wenjun Zeng, Zhangyang Wang
annotation: Introduces the comprehensive RESIDE benchmark dataset containing synthetic and real-world hazy scenes with standardized PSNR/SSIM evaluation protocols.

title: Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations
annotation: Establishes ImageNet-C and Mean Corruption Error (mCE) across 15 real-world noise, blur, weather, and digital corruption types.
